system.description:
You can spend a Force Point to imbue a specifically crafted weapon, armor, or article of clothing with the power of The Force. Imbuing the item requires a Full-Round Action. As a Full-Round Action, the wearer of such an item can open themselves to The Force, transferring one of their Force Points into the item. You can then use a Swift Action to spend a stored Force Point at any later time, even in the same round that you spend a Force Point of your own.

You can attune only one item per 24 hours, the item functions only for you, and a given item can only store one Force Point at a time. You cannot wear more than one attuned item at a time, and you can spend only up to a maximum of two Force Points in a round (one of your own, plus one from an imbued item).
